description: Utility functions for storing and retrieving notes using local storage, including functions to load and save notes, generate unique IDs, and derive titles from notes.

methods.name: loadNotes()
methods.description: Loads notes from local storage and returns them as an array. If no notes are found or an error occurs, returns an empty array.

methods.name: saveNotes
methods.description: Saves the provided notes array to local storage. Returns true if successful, false if an error occurs.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a simple UUID v4-like string.

methods.name: deriveTitle
methods.description: Derives a title for a note from its content. Uses the note's title if available, otherwise takes the first non-empty line from the content.
